description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and building command-line invocations for npm, specifically aimed at compatibility with Windows and Unix-like platforms. It provides mechanisms to find the appropriate npm executable, construct command-line arguments securely, and resolve the npm runner toolchain based on environment and platform.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Finds the environment variable key for the system PATH, prioritizes 'PATH' (case insensitive).

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes command line argument for Windows cmd.exe, ensuring no unsafe characters and proper quoting.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a command line string for cmd.exe with properly escaped arguments.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Determines the location and configuration of the npm CLI toolchain based on provided parameters.
